description_en: Imports data sources from your on-premises machine to a specific DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 批量导入本地数据源至目标DataWorks工作空间
name: ImportDataSources

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the data sources that you want to import. The Name, DataSourceType, SubType, Description, Content, and EnvType parameters are required. For more information about the parameters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211429.html
parameters.help_zh: 待导入数据源的数据源内容数组。其中Name，DataSourceType，SubType，Description，Content，EnvType参数为必填参数。参数的详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211429.html接口
parameters.name: data_sources

Data.description_en: The information about the imported data sources
Data.description_zh: 批量导入数据源的返回结果

Message.description_en: The reason why the data sources failed to be imported. If the data sources were imported, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh: 批量导入数据源失败后的原因描述。如果批量导入数据源成功，则该参数的返回值为空
Message.example: Data source DEV XXX already exists

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the data sources were imported. Valid values:

true: All data sources were imported.
false: Specific data sources failed to be imported. You can troubleshoot issues based on the Message parameter
Status.description_zh:
批量导入数据源的结果状态。取值如下：
true：表示全部数据源导入成功。
false：表示部分数据源导入失败，您可以查看Message参数定位失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
